words: Altogether I've 43000 US cents to spend - that's the whole lot, not a cent more to sow. Every item on the list should be there ready and waiting for me - none of them missing from the shelf. Here's the list so - 1 x portable monitors in silver, with a resolution of 1920 x 1080 or 2560 x 1600; 2 x home soundbars, speakers & subwoofers with 3-pin XLR connectivity; 1 x streaming media players with 6k resolution; and 1 x AV receivers & amplifiers with power consumption of 2000-3000. And another thing - my brother-in-law is hooking it up to the playroom telly for the kids. The av receivers & amplifiers needs to be one that suits the chosen portable monitors. Get the total down as far as it'll go. The home soundbars, speakers & subwoofers needs to be one that suits the chosen portable monitors. He's a terror for checking what's running the show inside any gadget before he'll sign off on it. I'll only receive 3 messages from you - anything after that is turned away. The streaming media players needs to be one that suits the chosen portable monitors. We've 129 steps - then we're finished - done or not.

Tools: summaryBalance(): Shows your meters: how much you've used so far and how much you've got left.; requestConclude(methodChoice=buy|refuse): Use this to finish up. With methodChoice=buy it orders the trolley, with methodChoice=refuse it gives up on the request, and either way the conversation is over; rangeScreen(costAtMost, itemGroup, make, rowRowStart): Looks for listings that match your search. You get 3 listings per call, and you choose the row offset to start from.; itemOpen(listingNumber): Opens up a single listing so you can look at it.; stashToBasket(entries): Sets the trolley contents. Whatever you send replaces the whole trolley with those lines, and you get the whole trolley back.; userSay(words): Sends a note to the user.; listingsLocate(freeQ, listFirst): Searches through listings and hands back 3 rows per call. Use a row offset to pick where to begin.; bag(): Shows what you've got in the trolley right now.; listingsMatchUp(chosenRefs): Lays out a comparison of listings in a single view, for up to 3 listings.
